name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
steps: Lie facedown on the floor with your forehead resting lightly down, glutes lightly braced, and arms extended diagonally overhead into a Y.
Lift both straight arms off the floor with thumbs pointing up, pause briefly, and lower smoothly.
Open your straight arms out into a T to lift and lower, then bend your elbows into a W and squeeze your upper back.
Flow smoothly through each letter in sequence while keeping your neck relaxed and ribs grounded.
tips: Keep your forehead down and lift through your mid and lower traps rather than hyperextending your lower back.
Hold each top contraction briefly with shoulders depressed away from your ears.
